IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. PAYROLL-OVERTIME.
*> Weekly pay: hours above 40 are paid at 1.5x. Tax is 20% if gross > 5000, else 10%.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WS-INPUT        PIC X(20).
01 WS-HOURS        PIC 9(3)V9.
01 WS-RATE         PIC 9(4)V99.
01 WS-REGULAR      PIC 9(7)V99.
01 WS-OVERTIME     PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
01 WS-GROSS        PIC 9(7)V99.
01 WS-TAX          PIC 9(7)V99.
01 WS-NET          PIC 9(7)V99.
01 WS-OUT          PIC Z(6)9.99.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
    ACCEPT WS-INPUT
    COMPUTE WS-HOURS = FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-INPUT)
    ACCEPT WS-INPUT
    COMPUTE WS-RATE = FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-INPUT)
    IF WS-HOURS > 40
        COMPUTE WS-REGULAR = 40 * WS-RATE
        COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME ROUNDED = (WS-HOURS - 40) * WS-RATE * 1.5
    ELSE
        COMPUTE WS-REGULAR ROUNDED = WS-HOURS * WS-RATE
    END-IF
    COMPUTE WS-GROSS = WS-REGULAR + WS-OVERTIME
    IF WS-GROSS > 5000
        COMPUTE WS-TAX ROUNDED = WS-GROSS * 0.20
    ELSE
        COMPUTE WS-TAX ROUNDED = WS-GROSS * 0.10
    END-IF
    COMPUTE WS-NET = WS-GROSS - WS-TAX
    MOVE WS-REGULAR TO WS-OUT
    DISPLAY "REGULAR PAY:  " WS-OUT
    MOVE WS-OVERTIME TO WS-OUT
    DISPLAY "OVERTIME PAY: " WS-OUT
    MOVE WS-GROSS TO WS-OUT
    DISPLAY "GROSS PAY:    " WS-OUT
    MOVE WS-TAX TO WS-OUT
    DISPLAY "TAX:          " WS-OUT
    MOVE WS-NET TO WS-OUT
    DISPLAY "NET PAY:      " WS-OUT
    STOP RUN.
explanation: The program calculates weekly pay from hours worked and an hourly rate. The first 40 hours are paid at the normal rate; hours above 40 are overtime, paid at 1.5 times the rate and rounded to 2 decimals. Tax is 20% of gross pay when gross is above 5000, otherwise 10%, rounded to 2 decimals. Regular pay, overtime pay, gross pay, tax and net pay are printed right-aligned in a 10-character edited field (PIC Z(6)9.99).

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. SUM-AVERAGE.
*> Reads N signed amounts and prints their sum, average, minimum and maximum.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WS-INPUT        PIC X(20).
01 WS-N            PIC 9(3).
01 WS-I            PIC 9(3).
01 WS-VALUE        PIC S9(7)V99.
01 WS-SUM          PIC S9(9)V99 VALUE 0.
01 WS-AVG          PIC S9(7)V99.
01 WS-MIN          PIC S9(7)V99.
01 WS-MAX          PIC S9(7)V99.
01 WS-OUT          PIC -(9)9.99.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
    ACCEPT WS-INPUT
    COMPUTE WS-N = FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-INPUT)
    IF WS-N = 0
        DISPLAY "NO DATA"
        STOP RUN
    END-IF
    PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > WS-N
        ACCEPT WS-INPUT
        COMPUTE WS-VALUE = FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-INPUT)
        ADD WS-VALUE TO WS-SUM
        IF WS-I = 1
            MOVE WS-VALUE TO WS-MIN WS-MAX
        ELSE
            IF WS-VALUE < WS-MIN MOVE WS-VALUE TO WS-MIN END-IF
            IF WS-VALUE > WS-MAX MOVE WS-VALUE TO WS-MAX END-IF
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM
    COMPUTE WS-AVG ROUNDED = WS-SUM / WS-N
    MOVE WS-SUM TO WS-OUT
    DISPLAY "SUM:     " FUNCTION TRIM(WS-OUT)
    MOVE WS-AVG TO WS-OUT
    DISPLAY "AVERAGE: " FUNCTION TRIM(WS-OUT)
    MOVE WS-MIN TO WS-OUT
    DISPLAY "MIN:     " FUNCTION TRIM(WS-OUT)
    MOVE WS-MAX TO WS-OUT
    DISPLAY "MAX:     " FUNCTION TRIM(WS-OUT)
    STOP RUN.
explanation: The program reads a count N and then N signed decimal amounts, one per line. It prints their sum, their average rounded to 2 decimals, the minimum and the maximum, each with a leading minus sign only when negative. If N is zero it prints "NO DATA" and stops.
